title: Finding / Note
description: Context discovered along the way — facts, gotchas, data realities, method limits — so a later agent doesn't have to rediscover it. NOT a decision (that's an ADR).

category.description: discovery=fact learned · gotcha=trap · data=dataset reality · method=how-to + its limits · source=a source's shape · risk=a way this can mislead/fail · context=general.

body_md.description: The finding in full, incl. limits/caveats.

status.description: standing = still true; superseded = replaced by a newer note.

relates_to.description: task/adr/feat this came from or informs.

asker.description: For a note tagged `question`: who asked, stamped once by the ask endpoint. First-class on purpose — provenance.agent becomes whoever LAST touched the note (the answerer, after an answer), so deriving the asker from provenance mis-addresses every re-answered reply.

to.description: For an addressed question or message: the one agent it is for. Empty on a question means the operator's; a question unanswered past the unstick window reaches every console regardless.

from_agent.description: Who sent this message or question, stamped once by the write seam and never rewritten by a later touch.

from_session.description: The sender's console session id (X-Hub-Session). A reply or an answer is routed back to THIS console, not to every console the sender has open.

session.description: For a message: the one recipient console it is addressed to. Mail for a console that has since ended falls through to that agent's most recently active live console.

machine.description: For a message: pin delivery to one of the recipient's machines.

tier.description: For a question: the asker's visibility tier when it was filed, so an answer is checked against what that tier may see. For a knowledge record: its prominence (`normal` | `foundational` — an environment fact the team cannot afford to lose; the unranked prompt index lists these first).

hop.description: For a question raised by an unattended run: how many unattended hops deep it is (absent/0 = a person or an attended session). Bounds agent-to-agent escalation chains.

verify.description: For a STATE claim (who has what, which port serves what, a measurement): the command or URL that answers it NOW. A state claim decays from the day it is written.

verified_as_of.description: The day the claim was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).

supersedes.description: The record this one corrects. The pointer is authoritative: every knowledge surface retires the target while this record is live.

superseded_by.description: Back-pointer stamped on a note retired by a correction.

related.description: Records this lesson may duplicate, correct or contradict — a SUSPICION recorded at write time (never a refusal), settled later by the adjudication pass.

z.description: semantic basis only: how unusual this closeness is for this corpus

shared.description: the terms that drove a lexical match, heaviest first

exact.description: the two rules are the same characters (similarity 1.0 alone does not mean that)

adjudicated_by.description: `rule`, or the model that read both records

related_partial.description: Overlap bases that did NOT run for this record. 'Nothing related' and 'the half that reads meaning could not run' are different facts.
